name: php-suite
description: Meta-bundle: the PHP category in one install — laravel (Laravel best practices and the Inertia.js skill behind one /laravel:review, plus the backend-engineer worker) and web-dev (the generalist worker, the frontend-reviewer, and the Vite skill for Laravel's default asset bundler via /web-dev:review). Uninstall cleanly with /php-suite:uninstall — removes the bundle and prunes its auto-installed plugins.
